_comment: N8N workflow for weekly automated blog post generation.
_usage: Import this file into N8N via Settings > Import Workflow. Then configure credentials: GitHub PAT, Anthropic API key, SSH key for deploy user.

A_weekly_blog_generator.description: Weekly CRON: GitHub API → Claude → SCP to container → SSH deploy

steps.name: Set Config
steps.description: Configure repo list and date range

steps.name: Fetch Commits Per Repo
steps.description: Loop over repos with SplitInBatches, call GitHub API for each

steps.name: Aggregate Activity
steps.description: Combine commits and issues into a structured summary for Claude

steps.name: Build Claude Prompt
steps.code:
const { commits, issues, today, repoList } = $input.first().json;

const prompt = `You are writing a weekly dev log for Zack Dell (zackdell.com).
Zack is a systems engineer focused on embedded systems, C++, PCB design, and manufacturing automation.

Output ONLY valid markdown with YAML frontmatter — no extra text, no code fences around the whole response.

Required frontmatter fields (copy exactly, including quotes):
---
title: "(descriptive title specific to this week's actual work)"
description: "(one sentence summary)"
pubDate: ${today}
tags: ["tag1", "tag2"]
draft: true
autoGenerated: true
sourceRepos: ${JSON.stringify(repoList)}
author: "Zack Dell"
---

Post body rules:
- First person, technical but readable
- 300-500 words
- Include specific technical details from commit messages and issues below
- Do NOT invent any details not present in the data
- draft is true — I will review before publishing

Activity data:
${JSON.stringify({ commits, issues }, null, 2)}`;

return [{ json: { prompt, today } }];

steps.name: Validate and Extract Markdown
steps.description: Check Claude returned valid frontmatter, prepare file content

steps.name: Write File to Container
steps.description: SCP markdown content to the container's blog content directory
steps._note: Configure SSH credential: host=<container-ip>, user=deploy, auth=privateKey. Store private key in N8N credentials, NOT here.

steps.name: Notify Success
steps.description: Send email notification on success (configure SMTP credentials)
steps.subject: =Blog draft published: {{ $('Validate and Extract Markdown').first().json.filename }}

errorHandling.description: If any step fails, N8N marks workflow execution as failed. The deploy script uses set -euo pipefail so build failures leave the previous release live. An error notification should be sent.

onError.subject: Blog automation failed
onError.text:
=Weekly blog workflow failed at step: {{ $execution.lastNodeExecuted }}
Error: {{ $execution.error?.message }}

B_manual_publish.description: Webhook trigger to publish a specific draft post

credentials_required.githubPat: GitHub Personal Access Token — fine-grained, read-only on Contents and Issues for target repos
credentials_required.anthropicApiKey: Anthropic API key (sk-ant-...) — used server-side, no CORS header needed
credentials_required.sshDeploy: SSH private key for the deploy@<container> user — generated on N8N host, public key added to /home/deploy/.ssh/authorized_keys on container
credentials_required.smtp: SMTP credentials for notification emails (optional — can replace with Slack/webhook)
